description: This file is a server-side module for managing account routes in a SvelteKit application. It handles loading account data from a Django REST API, transforming the data into a format suitable for front-end use, and provides actions for creating, updating, activating/deactivating, and deleting accounts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches account data from the API, processes the data structure, applies filters, and returns formatted account list along with pagination and filter options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new account by submitting form data to the API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing account information via API call based on form data.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates an account (sets is_active to false).

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates an account (sets is_active to true).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an account via API call.
